# Electrical & Computer Engineering | University of Utah

> > The Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering at the University of Utah conducts cutting-edge research in power systems, electromagnetics, wearable devices, robotics, and deep learning while preparing students for careers in technology and engineering.

Part of the John and Marcia Price College of Engineering, the department offers undergraduate and graduate programs including specialized tracks in power/control/robotics, graduate certificates in deep learning, and dual MS-MBA degrees. Faculty like Cynthia Furse, Florian Solzbacher, Jianli Chen, and Mostafa Sahraei-Ardakani lead research initiatives ranging from renewable energy microgrids for the Navajo Nation to biomedical wearables and antenna design.

## Key Topics

- Renewable energy and power systems
- Antenna design and electromagnetics
- Wearable devices and biomedical sensors
- Microgrids and rural electrification
- Deep learning and GPU computing
- Power electronics and control systems
- Robotics and neurorobotics
- Solar power and community infrastructure
- Tattoo antennas and flexible electronics
- Brain-computer interfaces
- Analog ML accelerators
- Thermal imaging and optical systems
- Navajo Nation energy access
- DOE and NSF funded research

## Academic Programs & Tracks

- [Tracks - Power, Control, Robotics](https://www.ece.utah.edu/tracks-power-control-robotics): Power engineering, control systems, and robotics academic track overview
- [Graduate Certificate: Deep Learning](https://www.ece.utah.edu/graduate-course-offerings/graduate-certificate-deep-learning): Graduate certificate program in deep learning and GPU computing
- [MBA Dual Degree](https://www.ece.utah.edu/graduate-programs-in-ece/combined-ms-mba-program): Combined MS-MBA dual degree program for engineering and business
- [Microwave Lab](https://www.ece.utah.edu/student-labs/microwave-lab): Student lab for microwave engineering courses ECE 3300, 5320, 5324

## Power Systems & Renewable Energy Research

- [POWERING UP A COMMUNITY](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2022/04/26/14524): Chen & Liu's microgrid project brings solar power to Navajo Nation
- [ECE Student Awarded Best Paper](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2021/05/14/ece-student-awarded-best-paper): Mingxi Liu wins best paper at NAPS for power transmission research
- [High-Power Wind Energy Conversion Systems](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2015/01/16/high-power-wind-energy-conversion-systems): Yaramasu seminar on wind energy conversion and power electronics

## Biomedical Devices & Wearable Technology

- [Sanchez Terrones develops real-time stress monitoring device](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2023/01/31/sanchez-terrones-develops-real-time-stress-monitoring-device): Sanchez Terrones creates IoMT wearable for real-time stress monitoring
- [Sanchez's Lab to Develop Wearable Device](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2021/07/28/sanchezs-lab-to-develop-wearable-device): Sanchez Lab receives contract for bioimpedance wearable development
- [ECE's Rebekah Doman presents research to Utah lawmakers](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2026/03/02/eces-rebekah-doman-presents-research-to-utah-lawmakers): Doman presents microwave cancer detection research to state lawmakers

## Electromagnetics & Antenna Innovation

- [IEEE Antennas and Propagation Society Doctoral Research Award](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2014/04/16/ieee-antennas-and-propagation-society-doctoral-research-award-2): Andrew Chrysler wins IEEE doctoral award for tattoo antenna research
- [Cynthia Furse Receives Pioneers of Progress Award](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2016/06/28/cynthia-furse-receives-pioneers-of-progress-award): Furse honored with Pioneers of Progress for LiveWire Innovation work
- [Thin to Win](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2019/10/08/thin-to-win): Meem's team develops ultra-thin optical lenses for thermal imaging

## Machine Learning & Computing Research

- [PhD Student Michael Keyser Studies Analog Accelerators Under NSF Fellowship](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2024/09/05/phd-student-michael-keyser-studies-analog-accelerators-under-nsf-fellowship): Keyser awarded NSF fellowship for analog ML accelerator research
- [ECE Research Assistant Aaron Wang, a High School Senior, earns Utah General Sterling Scholarship](https://www.ece.utah.edu/2023/04/10/ece-research-assistant-aaron-wang-a-high-school-senior-earns-utah-general-sterling-scholarship): High schooler Aaron Wang wins Sterling Scholarship for neurorobotics work
